notes: Story: Rho rematches now advance the story; already-finished steps are detected and skipped automatically
Story: longer, connected dialogue for every mission, a 10-panel opening story and a first-time controls tutorial
Starter choice is now a cutscene with 3 random first-stage Pokémon of 3 different types
7 side stories with their own characters and rewards (see Journey → Side stories)
Relay Express: ride a steam train between visited towns from the station outside each town
Battles: VS intro while the cards load, Pokémon-style HP plates and type-coloured moves
New settings: view distance, grass, FPS cap, shader effects, volumes, UI scale, text speed, FOV, camera shake, stick size, haptics
Fullscreen stays on until you switch to windowed in Settings (Esc no longer exits it); right-click menu disabled
Music pauses when the app goes to the background
Physics: no more sinking into hills; stand on docks, crates, stairs and platforms; partner swims with you; swim stamina at the island edge
Phone: faster rendering on High, shader warm-up before play, new thumb-arc buttons with icons, bigger text
New painted world map, 3D anime portraits, Mondstadt-style harbor houses, smoother zoom
